attributes.action: Make sharks the national animal of the UK
attributes.additional_details: We believe that having served the UK waters for so long, sharks should be considered to be a national animal. This will also increase education and awareness about all species of sharks, so will improve society on the whole.
attributes.background: The UK Government should give sharks the status of "National Animal".

rejection.details: The UK doesn't have a national animal status to be given by the Government to sharks, or to any other animal.
